summary.tldr: Removes GST from carbon pollution pricing charges and adds emission allowances to a GST-free list.
what_it_does: Excludes carbon pricing charges from the amount used to calculate GST, including charges under the Greenhouse Gas Pollution Pricing Act and provincial carbon levies.
Repeals subsection 221(2.1) and subsection 261(2.1) of the Excise Tax Act.
Updates the wording for self-assessed tax on real property when the supplier does not collect the tax.
Sets a four-year limit for reassessing certain GST on supplies covered by subsection 221(2).
Adds a new Schedule VI entry for a supply of emission allowances.
who_it_affects: People and businesses paying carbon pricing charges
summary.background: The bill amends the Excise Tax Act. The drafters say it would eliminate GST in respect of carbon pollution pricing.
